Around [[3640 BBY]], during the [[Galactic War]], the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], where he helped the young prodigy [[Gaden-Ko]] complete his journey as a [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]], despite the interference of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. As a result, Gaden-Ko joined the Jedi's crew.
